spans.s:
सृप् (ऌ) सृपॢ r. 1st. cl. (सर्पति)
 1. To go, to move.
 2. To creep, to crawl.
With अप, 1. To go from, to depart.
 2. To deviate from.
 3. To
espy. With उप, 1. To go near.
 2. To undergo.
 3. To go forth.
 4.
To move. With अनु, To approach. With उद्, To rise, to overflow.
With परि, To move to and fro. With प्र, 1. To proceed, to come
forth.
 2. To prevail, to spread. With वि, 1. To sneak about,
to fly about.
 2. To march, to proceed.
 3. To spread.
 4. To fall, to
flow.
 5. To disperse.
 6. To wind.
 7. To run away. With सम्, 1. To
flow.
 2. To glide.

सृपाट mf. (-टः-टी) A kind of measure.
 E. सृ to go, पाट aff.; or सृप्-काटन् ।

सृपाटिका f. (-का) The beak of a bird.
 E. सृ to go, पाट aff., कन् added,
fem. form.

सृप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Gone, going.
 E. सृप् to go, क्त aff.

सृप्र m. (-प्रः) The moon.
 E. सृप् to go, रक् Unādi aff.; or सृप्-क्रन् ।
